mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home and belongings before construction starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clearing out rooms, protecting or storing furniture, organizing key documents, and setting aside essentials you’ll need during construction help streamline the start of work and reduce the risk of damage.
